info.name: Invex API — Full Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection covering every endpoint in the Invex backend.

Setup:
1. Import Invex_Environment.json and select the 'Invex Local' environment.
2. Run 'Auth → Login (Admin)' first to populate {{adminToken}}.
3. Set {{userId}} and {{productId}} as needed for entity-specific calls.
